case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Framework renewal: volume and stable pricing
move.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

The forecast fc:350020@2026-09 shows 4,580 units annually, supporting a firm annual commitment.

The existing agreement ctr:4600070530 provides 90-day payment terms; we propose retaining these.

Could you share a cost breakdown separating materials, conversion costs and margin, and explain how a longer commitment would improve pricing? We seek a sustainable fixed price and propose the two packages below for your consideration. Would either support production planning sufficiently to achieve €412.74 per unit?

Best regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We appreciate your proposals, as a 36-month commitment improves our production planning and allows us to adjust our offer. Building on your second package, we can offer a price of €431.47 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our colleagues will address your questions regarding the cost breakdown and pricing basis separately. Our margin and our limits stay internal. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Renewal 4600070530 – fixed-price packages
move.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for improving your offer. Forecast fc:350020@2026-09 indicates growth of 10.3%, supporting predictable production planning.

Scorecard sc:70530@2026Q3 records 0 ppm, reinforcing our interest in continuing the relationship.

Could you clarify whether the price-reduction freeze also covers renewal agreements backed by a 36-month commitment? Could you provide the material and conversion cost breakdown without disclosing your internal margin?

We have increased our proposed price and offer the two packages below. Would retaining 90-day payment terms or accepting 60 days enable agreement on either package while supporting sustainable supply?

Best regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.subject: Renewal 4600070530 – payment terms at unchanged price
move.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for clarifying your pricing position. We will focus on payment terms rather than request another price reduction.

Could you agree to 90 days net at your unchanged unit price of €431.47, in exchange for the proposed 36-month commitment and firm annual volume? The complete package is set out below.

Would this allow us to retain established payment arrangements while giving your production team longer-term planning certainty?

Best regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We note your preference to retain a 90-day payment term. As the 36-month commitment and firm volume were already factored into our previous offer, extending the payment term requires an adjustment. 

We can therefore offer a unit price of €432.94 for a 90-day payment term. In total, our offer consists of a price of €432.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Framework renewal — payment-term adjustment
move.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Forecast fc:350020@2026-09 specifies 4,580 units annually, which we can commit to without overstating demand.

Agreement ctr:4600070530 provides 90-day payment terms, supporting continuity of the established arrangement.

Could you explain the financing basis for the €1.47 adjustment from 60 to 90 days? Rather than reopen the base price, could we agree a smaller financing adjustment and settle at €432.20 with 90 days net?

The package below retains the 36-month commitment and firm annual volume. Are there scheduling arrangements within that volume that would help reduce your financing or production costs?

Best regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
